code_paper_alignment.methodology_describ.reason: The Methodology misdescribes the production covariance assembly architecture. It claims workers write covariance columns directly into POSIX shared memory without serialization. The executed engine instead allocates and factorizes worker-local segment matrices and returns likelihood components and solution arrays through a multiprocessing pool. Sharing the input table through fork does not implement the claimed covariance writes.
